purpose.summary: Combine the existing upstream ALP and public synthetic plugin oracles on one real bounded-regtest daemon graph across the full token lifecycle, process reopen and reorg.
scope: Direct child of the accepted public PR56 head; two new test clients and finite policy/documentation changes only.
Reuse unchanged public ALP builders/export, native RPC/HTTP daemon wrapper, ALP metadata/color/wire oracle and existing synthetic plugin data decoder.
Observe GENESIS1000, MINT500, SEND1400+100 and BURN100 with the existing public plugin active, including exact input ancestry and baton metadata.
Require both ALP and plugin response commitments across pending/confirmed fresh-process reopens and confirmation/disconnect/reconsider.
Retain all five profiles, previous clients and exact matrices, deadlines, assertions, durability and cleanup laws.
Bind the unchanged compiled projection separately from exact new test/reused public input commitments before and after execution.
exclusions: No production source, token parser/validator, plugin engine/source, dependency, consensus, activation or default change.
No arbitrary/operator plugin, new listener, WebSocket/broadcast, Python sandbox or full-chain/production readiness claim.
No incoming private report, history, binary, operator data, server deployment, desktop integration or proof promotion.

limitations: Test-only bounded unpruned local regtest, not full-chain availability, latency, power-loss recovery, funded token economics, deployment or independent reproduction.
Existing exact trusted public synthetic plugin only; Python is not sandboxed. Operator plugin configuration, actual-daemon version change/rebuild and server migration remain separate later work.
Original ALP invalid-mint/malformed-metadata and plugin refusal controls remain separate and unchanged; this combined client covers the valid four-operation lifecycle only.

Compiled adapter inputs are unchanged and separately bound. Test inputs are independently hashed; neither CMake cache/source checks nor those commitments prove that an externally supplied binary was built from the paired source.

All native values/fees are zero. Synthetic mining priority is not currency. Rust registry inputs are locked, OS/SDK/runner inputs are not. Upstream alerts and historical timeout counterevidence remain open.
counterevidence: PR56's seven Linux CI checks passed on95143c437e45f64ea74a695251d4f6cd474ef8de. This does not remove its local normal stop/reopen repetition3 aggregate60s refusal, establish every cause or qualify diagnostic instrumentation as replacement evidence.

Separate ALP and plugin client successes did not establish their combined behavior. This new same-graph oracle requires its own actual-daemon run; metadata and synthetic rejection tests are not execution evidence.
No incoming report or automatic proof promotion. This record starts Open Question/record-review-only; observations must be generated and reviewed separately.
